title: Automotive Clearcoat, Metallic Flake & Anisotropy
visual_specification: 900x560 original speed-form hood/fender with visible procedural metallic flake, dual-lobe clearcoat and a separate brushed anisotropic rotor under two CPU area emitters.
publication_note: Candidate only; no borrowed car model or external art. Runtime evidence is pending the integrated material-quality host.
limitations: Flecks are original albedo modulation over a metallic undercoat; no per-flake geometry BSDF is claimed.
Rotor uses scalar tangent-frame brushing, not a directional anisotropy texture.
